title: Gradle subprojects and an included build
expected: Respect subprojects plus composite-build dependency substitution.
Prepare Gradle and JDK before execution; wrapper-generated downloads must obey acquisition routing.
Expose implicit lint and read-only formatting checks; explicit format may rewrite sources, but build never does.

cases.name: wrapper-request
cases.change: Generate a wrapper for an approved Gradle distribution.
cases.expect: Validate distribution checksum and route; wrapper execution cannot bypass managed acquisition.

cases.name: lint-failure
cases.change: Add an unused java.util.Random import to an application source file.
cases.expect: Native compilation/tests can succeed, but lint fails, artifacts are blocked, test evidence is retained and source stays unchanged.

cases.name: format-failure
cases.change: Add an extra space between public and class in an application source file.
cases.expect: Read-only formatting fails and blocks artifacts without changing source; explicit oyzu run format can repair it.

limitations: Installed-Gradle fixture; wrapper generation/integrity variant is specified but not checked in or verified.
Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
